info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Event Management API
info.description: The Event Management API facilitates the creation and management of events within a microservice architecture. This API allows clients to submit event details, enabling seamless integration with open banking applications. It's designed for developers creating applications that require event-driven functionalities, such as transaction notifications or status updates. Typical consumers include financial service providers and application developers seeking to enhance user engagement through real-time event handling.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new event in the system. You need to provide the necessary details for the event in the request body.

requestBody.description: The body of the request contains details about the event to be created. It should follow the defined schema for proper validation and data integrity. Ensure that all required fields are included and correctly formatted.
